a.xlink:title: Loop through the file table until the file with specified name is found.
Loop through the file table until it finds a free index.
Reads the file table into entries.
Reads the super block and checks validity.
Copies source to destination so that destination is TINYFS_NAME_LENGTH.
Check that strlen(name) fits inside TINYFS_NAME_LENGTH and that it's not NULL or starts with NULL.
Calculate how many sectors size_bytes takes up.
Check if the drive is ready before disk read/write. This uses pooling so it is blocking.
Move HDD head to the correct position on the disk for I/O.
Just runs inb() against ATA disk 4 times.
